files.README.md:
# Job Toolkit
Dependency-free Node ESM modules for a tenant-aware job platform. Public exports
live in src/index.mjs; each package is also directly importable through its own
src/index.mjs. Existing functions: sameTenant(principal, resource),
escapeCell(value), retryDelay(attempt, baseMs, capMs). Existing behavior must remain
compatible. npm test runs package and root suites; npm run coverage measures
owned source. No installs or network are needed.

request:
Finish the Job Toolkit release in <PROJECT>. The platform needs usable access policies, CSV interchange, and a retryable job queue. Preserve existing exports and behavior, expose the new APIs through each package and the root barrel, and update the README with examples and errors.

Access package: Add compilePolicy(rules), returning a deeply immutable policy, and authorize(policy, principal, resource, action), returning a frozen { allowed, reason, matchedRule }. Rules are an ordered array of { id, effect, actions, resourceTypes, roles }, where id is a unique nonempty string, effect is 'allow' or 'deny', and each list is nonempty distinct nonempty strings. '*' matches any action/type/role but may only appear alone in that list. Invalid rules raise TypeError('policy'); caller mutation must not alter the compiled policy. Principals are { tenant, roles }, resources are { tenant, type, id }. Invalid or missing nonempty tenant/action/type/id or invalid principal roles yield { allowed:false, reason:'invalid', matchedRule:null } without throwing. Cross-tenant requests yield reason 'tenant' before considering rules. Within a tenant, a rule matches when action and resource type match and at least one principal role matches (a '*' role rule also matches a valid empty role array). Any matching deny beats every allow; select the first matching deny in input order. Otherwise select the first matching allow. Selected rules return reason 'deny'/'allow' and matchedRule equal to their id. No match returns false/'default'/null. export explainBatch(policy, requests) to decide an array of { principal, resource, action } without state changes, rejecting a non-array argument with TypeError('requests'). authorize must reject an uncompiled policy with TypeError('policy') and use only validated compiled state, never trusting arbitrary objects with a rules property.

CSV package: Add parseCsv(text), returning arrays of string cells, with comma separator, double-quote escaping, embedded newlines inside quotes, CRLF/LF/CR row separators, and an optional initial UTF-8 BOM. Empty input returns []; a trailing row separator does not create an extra row, but blank rows within input are ['']. Reject quote characters inside an unquoted field, characters other than delimiter/newline after a closing quote, and unterminated quoted fields with SyntaxError('csv'); nonstring input raises TypeError('csv'). Preserve whitespace and literal content, including quoted CRLF. Add stringifyCsv(rows), requiring an array of nonempty arrays of string cells, otherwise TypeError('rows'); emit CRLF between records and no trailing separator, and [] becomes ''. Preserve existing escapeCell semantics.

Add importJobs(text, tenant): parse a header plus zero or more records with exact required columns id,type,payload,priority in any order. Reject missing/duplicate/unknown columns, wrong row widths, invalid/nonempty tenant/id/type, duplicate ids, malformed JSON payloads, non-object/array/null payloads, or priority other than a canonical decimal integer from 0 through 9 with TypeError('jobs'). Each record returns { id,tenant,type,payload,priority }. An empty file is invalid, a valid header alone returns []. Parsing syntax failures remain SyntaxError('csv'). Add exportJobs(jobs,tenant) using header id,type,payload,priority in that order. Validate all records before producing output, reject a foreign tenant or invalid/duplicate record with TypeError('jobs'), and produce a deterministic round-trip for JSON-safe object payloads. It must reject NaN/Infinity/undefined/functions/cycles in payloads instead of silently losing values. Caller data must remain unchanged.

Queue package: Add createQueue({ now=Date.now, maxAttempts=3, baseMs=10, capMs=1000 } = {}). Invalid option types, non-positive safe integer values, or capMs < baseMs raise TypeError('configuration'). Enqueue via enqueue(tenant, id, payload, key), with nonempty string tenant/id/key and a detached JSON-safe object payload. Invalid input raises TypeError('job'). Each new job has {tenant,id,payload,status:'queued',attempts:0,availableAt:now(),leaseUntil:null,token:null,result:null,error:null} and is deeply frozen. Duplicate ids are disallowed within a tenant (Error('job exists')); successful enqueue keys are scoped by tenant, exact same id/payload replay returns the original queued object even after transitions, and changed payload/id raises Error('key conflict'). Payload object-key order does not affect equality. Invalid/failed calls create no durable state. Tenant ids may repeat across tenants.

claim(tenant, leaseMs) expires due leases globally first, validates a nonempty tenant and positive safe integer leaseMs (TypeError('claim')), and returns null if nothing ready. Select queued jobs for that tenant with availableAt <= now(), in insertion order; claiming changes status to 'running', increments attempts once, assigns a fresh opaque token and leaseUntil = now()+leaseMs, and returns the immutable new record. expireLeases() transitions running jobs with leaseUntil <= now(): if attempts >= maxAttempts then 'failed', otherwise 'queued' at now()+retryDelay(attempts,baseMs,capMs). It clears token/leaseUntil, sets error:'lease expired', and returns transitioned records. Expiration is processed by claim, complete, fail, get, and list; enqueue and snapshot do not expire. A failed requested call may still expire due leases.

complete(tenant,id,token,result) requires a current unexpired running lease and valid detached JSON-safe result (any JSON value is allowed); changes status to 'succeeded', result to supplied result, error to null, token and leaseUntil to null. fail(tenant,id,token,message) with a nonempty string message either schedules queued retry with the delay above or marks failed after maxAttempts; it clears lease fields and stores message. Wrong tenant/missing id raises Error('job'), wrong or stale token/non-running status raises Error('lease'), invalid result/message raises TypeError('result')/TypeError('message'). State is unchanged on rejection except due expirations. get(tenant,id) returns the current immutable record or null; list(tenant) returns a detached array. snapshot() returns a detached JSON-safe object capturing jobs, options, replay records, ordering and token state with version:1. Add restoreQueue(snapshot,{now}={}), rejecting malformed/inconsistent state with TypeError('snapshot'), restoring in-flight leases and successful replay semantics, never trusting or mutating the caller's snapshot. Reject duplicate ids/keys/tokens, invalid references/status/attempt counts/timestamps/JSON values, and token/lease fields inconsistent with status. Snapshot restoration must not enable an old token to finish a different lease. Unsafe timestamp arithmetic raises RangeError('time') before requested state mutation; now() must return a nonnegative safe integer. A replay returns the same object within the restored instance.

Read the installed global instructions at <GLOBAL_INSTRUCTIONS> and the project's AGENTS.md and follow normal available workflows. Work only in this disposable checkout; no installs, external services, commits, pushes, or global changes. Return implemented behavior, changed files, verification results and limitations. Keep commands and instruction-file paths actually read in outputs/implementation-log.md. Do not access the surrounding parent workspace.
